definition.title: Theme Switch
definition.desc: Choose Light, Dark or Auto with a sliding indicator. Auto follows the operating system and emits the effective preference without changing the library shell.
definition.seen: Pattern family: three-way appearance preferences in application settings
definition.hint: Press · The selector glides between light, dark and system

definition.title: Badge Pop
definition.desc: The notification badge pops as new messages arrive. Rapid additions queue from the committed count; pause and reset stay available in the shared dock.
definition.seen: Pattern family: queued unread counts and notification arrival feedback
definition.hint: Ambient · The badge pops as the count ticks up
definition.html: 12

definition.title: Polish Stages
definition.desc: Choose Fill, Border, Light or Depth to add one layer of polish to a persistent button. The final layer demonstrates hover and press before returning to Fill.
definition.seen: Pattern family: progressive component material and interaction walkthroughs
definition.hint: Press · Add one layer of polish at a time

definition.title: Liquid Progress
definition.desc: A native liquid sync indicator keeps its target independent of wave phase. Press the vessel to fill the remaining library; inspect, pause and reset through the dock.
definition.seen: Seen on: uploads, onboarding completion, sustainability metrics, storage meters, and playful goal tracking
definition.hint: Ambient · Liquid rises with a gentle surface
